bare.caption: The ALab character before fur, with its native rigid tail tuft visible.
bare.provenance: Rendered from examples/alab/stoat-bare.usda and the locally consolidated ALab stoat01.usdc, using the same HeroCam and studio light/floor settings as the groom image.

guides.caption: Sparse cyan guides establish the coat's comb direction before the dense fur is grown.
guides.provenance: Rendered from the authored guide curves in examples/alab/stoat-guides.usda.

groom.caption: Guide-driven usdGen fur on the ALab skin; the study uses a fitted smooth tail emitter to replace the visible native tuft spikes.
groom.provenance: Rendered from 188,914 native BasisCurves baked from the six usdGen descriptions in examples/alab/stoat-groom.usda, with the matching ALab geometry, skeleton and materials. Studio lighting is authored in renders/docs/operators/stoat_final_studio.usda.

detail.caption: A closer view of the short facial fur and tapered fibres around the muzzle and ears.
detail.provenance: Rendered from the same 188,914 cooked native usdGen BasisCurves as the approved groom image, through /World/DetailCam and the matching MoonRay studio lighting.

steps.title: Prepare the asset
steps.body: Run tools/prepare_alab.py prepare to fetch the official ALab stoat and consolidate its render geometry, materials, skin bindings and 44-joint skeleton into out/alab/stoat01.usdc.

steps.title: Build the study
steps.body: Run python -S tools/make_stoat_groom.py to write the bare, sparse-guide and groom USD layers. The groom layer references the local ALab asset.

steps.title: Shape the coat
steps.body: Face subsets divide the ALab skin into brown back, cream belly, brown head and short cream face. Sparse curves guide Scatter, Guide Interpolate, Noise and Width. Mouth faces stay bare.

steps.title: Compare the results
steps.body: Use the matching HeroCam in the bare and groom stages; DetailCam shows individual facial fibres. The groom is static and does not claim skeleton-driven deformation.

notes: The ALab source asset and its license remain outside the MIT-licensed source tree.
The outfit and backpack are preserved in the consolidated asset but hidden in the groom study to expose the body.
The visible groom tail tuft uses a smooth proxy fitted to the ALab tuft bounds; the original mesh is preserved and shown in the bare comparison.
The study overrides eye presentation materials but does not alter the consolidated source asset.
